project_title: DEMON-71 | Advanced Tactical Unit & Surveillance System

team_members.name: Tarek Ahmed Tanbir (তারেক আহমেদ তানভীর)
team_members.role: Project Director & Hardware Engineer (প্রকল্প পরিচালক ও হার্ডওয়্যার ইঞ্জিনিয়ার)

rover_overview.name: DEMON-71 (Rover 71)
rover_overview.tagline: Next-Generation Autonomous Explorer & Tactical Defense Rover
rover_overview.mission_summary: DEMON-71 is capable of direct platoon-level real-time intelligence sharing. It detects armed terrorists and threats, transmitting live feeds to Headquarters (HQ). Its electronic warfare jamming module neutralizes drone attacks, while specialized robotic arms, Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR), gas sensors, and AES-256 security protocols ensure multi-mission battlefield superiority.

tactical_modules.name: Bomb Defusal Module (বোমা নিষ্ক্রিয়করণ ইউনিট)
tactical_modules.description: Uses a high-precision 5-axis robotic arm and HD camera for safe-distance analysis and defusal of hazardous explosives.

tactical_modules.name: AI Surveillance System (এআই সার্ভেইল্যান্স)
tactical_modules.description: Monitors target areas in real-time using computer vision and object recognition to identify hostile vs friendly entities and alert HQ.

tactical_modules.name: Mine Detection Unit (মাইন ডিটেকশন ইউনিট)
tactical_modules.description: Scans terrain using Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) sensors to locate buried landmines in forests, deserts, or mud, sending real-time coordinates to HQ.

tactical_modules.name: Network Jamming Unit (নেটওয়ার্ক জ্যামিং মডিউল)
tactical_modules.description: Electronic Warfare module that detects hostile drones or radio signals and immediately transmits high-power noise signals to sever enemy communications.

tactical_modules.name: Environment Monitoring (পরিবেশ পর্যবেক্ষণ মডিউল)
tactical_modules.description: Monitors atmospheric parameters and detects toxic chemical/gas leaks in real-time, uploading sensor telemetries to the cloud.

tactical_modules.name: Security & Tracking Protocols (নিরাপত্তা প্রোটোকল)
tactical_modules.description: Enforces live satellite-linked GPS tracking for rescue ops, AES-256 bit encrypted communications, physical tamper protection, and automatic self-destruct data wiping if capture risk is detected.

future_upgrades.title: Night Vision 2.0 (নাইট ভিশন ২.০)
future_upgrades.description: Adding thermal imaging and low-light enhancement for clear target identification in total darkness.

future_upgrades.title: Autonomous Navigation (স্বয়ংক্রিয় ন্যাভিগেশন)
future_upgrades.description: Integrating LiDAR and GPS waypoint navigation for operator-free autonomous traversal.

future_upgrades.title: Deep Learning Core (ডিপ লার্নিং কোর)
future_upgrades.description: Upgrading neural networks beyond YOLOv8 for sub-second precision threat forecasting.
